y-m-34-05.title: Ukuba ulingano lulunge, ingaba lwamkelwa njengesiphumo sokwahlula nesishiyekileyo?
y-m-34-05.topic: Ukwahlula ipolynomial: imeko yokuba sisiphumo sokwahlula nesishiyekileyo nokuba A=BQ+R iyasebenza
y-m-34-05.goal: Qinisekisa wena ukuba zikho ezininzi (Q,R) apho A=B·Q+R isebenza, uqonde ukuba imeko ngebakala lesishiyekileyo ifuneka ukuzamkela njengesiphumo sokwahlula nesishiyekileyo, uze uqhubeke nokwahlula ngokumisela impendulo engahambelani nemeko.
y-m-34-05.material:
Hlula A(x)=x³+2x²+3x+4 nge-B(x)=x²+1. Abafundi abathathu bathi oku kulandelayo, yaye bonke abathathu baqinisekisa ukuba 'A=B·Q+R iyasebenza'.
  Jimin: isiphumo sokwahlula Q=x+2, isishiyekileyo R=2x+2
  Harin: isiphumo sokwahlula Q=x+1, isishiyekileyo R=x²+2x+3
  Doyun: isiphumo sokwahlula Q=x, isishiyekileyo R=2x²+2x+4

y-m-34-05.s.s1.prompt: Yenza izibini ezongezelelweyo (Q,R) apho A=B·Q+R isebenza. Misela Q=x+p, R=ux²+vx+w (p, u, v, w ngamanani aphelele), uze ufumane izibini ezintathu ezahlukileyo kwizibini ezanikwa ngabafundi abathathu ngentla yaye ezinamaxabiso ahlukeneyo e-p.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala Q=x+p uze wandise B·Q. Ukuba uyisusa leso siphumo kwi-A, kufuneka sibe yi-R.
y-m-34-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tshintsha p inani eliphelele elinye ngexesha (utsibe amaxabiso asetyenziswe ngabafundi abathathu), bala umlinganiselo ngamnye we-R, uze wenze itafile.

y-m-34-05.s.s1.explain: B·(x+p)=x³+px²+x+p, ngoko R=A-B·Q=(2-p)x²+2x+(4-p). p=2 yimpendulo kaJimin, p=1 yimpendulo kaHarin, p=0 yimpendulo kaDoyun, kwaye zikho ezininzi ngakumbi kangangoko ufuna, ezinje nge-p=3 okanye p=-1.
y-m-34-05.s.s2.prompt: Nangona zikho izibini ezininzi (Q,R) ezinjalo, sisiphi isivumelwano esifunekayo ukuthetha ngo 'siphumo sokwahlula nesishiyekileyo sokwahlula' njengesinye?
